title: VLM Readouts for DRC Hotspot Detection: code, prompts and results
description: Code, exact prompts and saved per-region results accompanying the article 'Vision-Language Readouts for DRC Hotspot Detection: A Calibrated CNN Baseline and a Matched-Control Test of Multi-Agent Debate' (IEEE Access, submitted). The metrics in Tables II–XI and XIII–XVI and Figs. 4–11 of the article can be recomputed from the saved results with `make reproduce`, without running any model.
